name: Electrolyte - Pack of 15
subtitle: Open. Stir Stir Stir. Drink up!

description:
Made for active kids who sweat, play, and run all day. Because water alone isn't always enough.

  Little Joys Electrolyte helps replenish essential electrolytes lost through sweat.

  With steady energy, vitamins, probiotics, and immunity support built in.

  Made with orange fruit + coconut water powders.

  ZERO white sugar. NO artificial colours or flavors.

  Perfect after sports, school, travel, or hot summer days.

  For ages 4+. Not for medicinal use.

How to Use

  
    🥤 Step 1: Open one sachet (11g).
    💧 Step 2: Pour into 180ml of water (about ¾ of a regular glass). Use chilled water for best taste.
    🥄 Step 3: Stir well and serve.

reviews.author: Vishal Chavan
reviews.body: Electrolyte is a game-changer! It's the perfect balance of electrolytes (sodium, potassium, and magnesium) without the junk found in other sports drinks. My kids love the taste, it dissolves easily, and it's their go-to after football practice

reviews.author: Simran Bajaj
reviews.body: Electrolyte is effective and clean, exactly what we were looking for. The refreshing flavor is a bonus!

reviews.author: Darshan Kale
reviews.body: I chose Electrolyte as a clean way to replenish my kid's energy after sports. It's a great product, and I love how quickly it energizes them
